gloss: before the spirit of the deceased

definitions.gloss: before the spirit of the deceased
definitions.explanation: The place in front of a dead person's spirit; in practice, the altar or photograph set up at a wake or funeral, where offerings are made.

examples.japanese: {霊前|れいぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: To offer flowers before the spirit of the deceased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{霊前|れいぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: I put my hands together in prayer before the deceased's altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{宗派|しゅうは}→宗派：31899_shuuha⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: It is usual to write 御霊前 on a condolence-money envelope, but some Buddhist sects do not use it.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霊前|れいぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to offer before the deceased
- ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧: "before the spirit" — written on condolence-money envelopes
- {霊前|れいぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report news to the deceased

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧ is the usual inscription on a ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧ envelope at a wake or funeral. Jodo Shinshu Buddhists, who hold that the dead become buddhas at once, write ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧ instead, and other Buddhists switch to ⟦{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}→御仏前：29764_gobutsuzen⟧ after the 49th-day service.
